themes.title: Far-Right Stances on Foreign Conflicts and Security
themes.blurb: Right-wing and nationalist figures across multiple nations are actively navigating foreign policy challenges, particularly regarding the war in Ukraine and Middle East conflicts. US diplomatic envoys hold high-level talks in Moscow and Kyiv while European right-wing parties face intense domestic debate and scrutiny over their positioning toward Russia and international security.

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges

French RN leaders forged an agreement with British right-wing figures to return Channel migrants, while the US administration continues high-profile immigration crackdowns.

themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: European populist and far-right parties are using strong polling performance and municipal election strategies to solidify their influence. Right-wing movements in France, Sweden, and Norway are challenging established ruling parties by appealing to voter discontent over local security and national governance.

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions

These symbolic policy moves aim to push back against progressive cultural reforms and reassert nationalist identity within state structures.

themes.title: Right-Wing Parties Battle Electoral Rules and Funding Scrutiny
